sourceTitle: GPT-6.1 Sol helps CodeRabbit strengthen security across complex codebases
originalTitle: GPT‑6.1 Sol helps CodeRabbit strengthen security across complex codebases
author: OpenAI

blocks.text: As AI accelerates software development, engineering and application-security teams need ways to investigate code changes and address vulnerabilities while keeping people in control. CodeRabbit is using GPT‑6.1 Sol as the primary model in its security agent to extend review beyond individual changes and help developers understand risks across complex codebases.
blocks.en: As AI accelerates software development, engineering and application-security teams need ways to investigate code changes and address vulnerabilities while keeping people in control. CodeRabbit is using GPT‑6.1 Sol as the primary model in its security agent to extend review beyond individual changes and help developers understand risks across complex codebases.
blocks.zh: 随着 AI 加速软件开发，工程和应用安全团队需要能够在保持人为掌控的同时，分析代码变更并修复漏洞的方法。CodeRabbit 将 GPT‑6.1 Sol 用作其安全智能体的主要模型，让审查不再局限于单次变更，帮助开发者理解复杂代码库中的风险。

blocks.text: A pull request can affect shared libraries, dependencies and safeguards elsewhere in an application. GPT‑6.1 Sol helps CodeRabbit connect behavior across files and components to surface potential security issues. CodeRabbit’s review is independent of the agent that wrote the code and complements established scanners. Its system also uses other frontier models and security tooling.
blocks.en: A pull request can affect shared libraries, dependencies and safeguards elsewhere in an application. GPT‑6.1 Sol helps CodeRabbit connect behavior across files and components to surface potential security issues. CodeRabbit’s review is independent of the agent that wrote the code and complements established scanners. Its system also uses other frontier models and security tooling.
blocks.zh: 一个 pull request 可能影响应用其他部分的共享库、依赖项和防护机制。GPT‑6.1 Sol 帮助 CodeRabbit 关联分析不同文件和组件中的代码行为，从而发现潜在的安全问题。CodeRabbit 的审查独立于编写代码的智能体，并与现有扫描工具形成互补。其系统还使用了其他前沿模型和安全工具。

blocks.text: During pull-request review, Sol helps analyze changes as developers work. In Deep Scan, it supports broader investigation across repositories, including dependencies and how components interact. CodeRabbit Secure extends that investigation to linked repositories, such as a shared authentication library, to help teams understand how a weakness could affect the wider system.
blocks.en: During pull-request review, Sol helps analyze changes as developers work. In Deep Scan, it supports broader investigation across repositories, including dependencies and how components interact. CodeRabbit Secure extends that investigation to linked repositories, such as a shared authentication library, to help teams understand how a weakness could affect the wider system.
blocks.zh: 在 pull request 审查过程中，Sol 会随着开发者的工作进展，协助分析变更。在深度扫描中，它支持对代码仓库进行更广泛的分析，包括依赖项以及组件之间的交互方式。CodeRabbit Secure 将分析范围扩展到关联的代码仓库，例如共享身份验证库，帮助团队了解一处薄弱环节可能如何影响更大范围的系统。

blocks.text: CodeRabbit reports using GPT‑6.1 Sol to flag security-related issues across thousands of repositories and organizations. These findings feed into the pull-request workflows developers already use to review and improve their code.
blocks.en: CodeRabbit reports using GPT‑6.1 Sol to flag security-related issues across thousands of repositories and organizations. These findings feed into the pull-request workflows developers already use to review and improve their code.
blocks.zh: 据 CodeRabbit 介绍，它已使用 GPT‑6.1 Sol 在数千个代码仓库和组织中标记安全相关问题。这些发现会纳入开发者原本就用于审查和改进代码的 pull request 工作流。

blocks.text: CodeRabbit Secure connects investigation to remediation. For user-selected findings, it can attempt exploit verification in an isolated sandbox without testing production systems. For supported issues, it can draft a pull request with a proposed fix for a person to review and approve.
blocks.en: CodeRabbit Secure connects investigation to remediation. For user-selected findings, it can attempt exploit verification in an isolated sandbox without testing production systems. For supported issues, it can draft a pull request with a proposed fix for a person to review and approve.
blocks.zh: CodeRabbit Secure 将问题分析与修复衔接起来。对于用户选定的发现，它可以在隔离沙盒中尝试验证漏洞能否被利用，而无需在生产系统中测试。对于支持处理的问题，它可以起草包含修复建议的 pull request，交由人工审查和批准。

blocks.text: This work shows how frontier reasoning can support software security: understanding risks beyond an individual change, helping validate findings and turning them into proposed fixes. Human reviewers remain responsible for deciding which changes to ship.
blocks.en: This work shows how frontier reasoning can support software security: understanding risks beyond an individual change, helping validate findings and turning them into proposed fixes. Human reviewers remain responsible for deciding which changes to ship.
blocks.zh: 这项工作展示了前沿推理能力如何为软件安全提供支持：理解单次变更之外的风险，协助验证发现的问题，并据此提出修复方案。最终仍由人工审查者决定哪些变更可以发布。
